children: DigitalOcean entered into an Equipment Finance Facility to fund data center hardware purchases. The facility provides $725 million of committed financing with an accordion feature for up to an additional $300 million, subject to lender commitments. Advances may fund up to 90% of equipment cost through September 10, 2027, with leases amortizing to September 10, 2030. Pricing is a fixed rate set at a term SOFR swap plus 2.75%, with commitment fees of 0.20% on undrawn amounts, rising to 0.40% after six months; prepayments carry a 5% premium in year one and 3% in year two.
: Secured equipment finance lease facility with accordion
: MUFG Americas Capital Leasing & Finance as Lessor; MUFG Bank as Administrative Agent, and rent assignees
: Advances through Sep 10 2027; amortize to Sep 10 2030
: Fund data center equipment purchases and support growth with flexible financing
